label: Every per se ordered efficient-cause link is a PER_SE_5 actual CAUSE_2 of being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst framework premise, attribution deferred: whenever c causes x as a caused cause (CausesAsCaused, sense SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3 of DEF 4a101a4c, the per se link of the secunda via's series of efficient causes), c is a per se actual cause of the being of x in the q.3 a.4 profile (PerSeActualEsseCause, PER_SE_5, DEF 4bca086d): c is other than x, both are in act as to being (ActualEsseCause, DEF 8163859b), c causes the esse of x (CausesIn c x esse, CAUSE_2, mode unspecified, tenseless), and it does so as caused (the primitive per se link AsCaused c x). It is not stated for accidentally ordered causes. Assessment: it fails on the bound sense SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3, which the proved statement c2880fe0 (PerSeMoverLinkIsPerSeCauseLinkReading, with stating claim 712924b7 on ST I q.46 a.2 ad 7) extends to per se mover links; with c2880fe0 it entails that every per se mover is a per se actual cause of the moved thing's esse. Ad 7 gives as per se series the stone moved by the stick, moved by the hand, and the generation of this man depending on this man, the elementary body and the sun ('ab hoc homine, et a corpore elementari, et a sole'), causes of motion and of coming to be. That the stick continues to be when the hand lets go is an analyst observation, not ad 7's. It is defensible only under an existential sense of CausesAsCaused; that sense is now SERIES_OF_CAUSES_4 (definition 57348ddc, an analyst sense), on which the premise is restated as a separate statement with its own derivations (specs/dependence-order-senses.toml); this statement keeps the bound sense SERIES_OF_CAUSES_3.
